plugins.name: paper-conductor
plugins.description: All-in-one assistant for academic paper writing across 8 stages (topic → research → draft → figures → polish → review → defense → submission). Drafts, polishes, does first-pass review, and plans the route itself; recommends and hands off to stronger specialized skills when a stage needs them.
